events.text: A travelling examiner of the sects sets a black testing stone in the village square, and every child in the village lines up to touch it. Most of them make it glow a muddy mix of colours. When your turn comes, the examiner reads the light for a long moment: you have {roots}.

effects.log: "It means which way your qi will want to go," the examiner says. "Fire to the fist, water to the feet, metal to the sword. Few roots, fast road. Many roots, long road." Then the examiner moves on to the next child.

choices.text: Touch it again, harder, to see if it changes

effects.log: It does not change. The examiner laughs. "Roots are roots," the examiner says. "What you grow on them is your business."

events.text: Word of your root has travelled. Two sect envoys arrive at your house on the same afternoon, and each of them explains, very politely, that the other is a fraud. A pure root comes once in a generation, and both of them intend to go home with it.

choices.text: Make them argue it out in front of the whole village

effects.log: They argue until sunset. The village has not been this entertained in years. Neither wins, and both promise to come back.

choices.text: Tell them you will choose your own sect when you are ready

effects.log: They look at each other, for once in agreement: this one is going to be trouble. Then they leave you their sects' tokens anyway.

events.text: The other children have heard about your root: all five elements, muddy and even, the kind the examiners call a false root. "Five roots, no road," they chant, which is the oldest joke in the murim and has never once been funny.

choices.text: Train twice as hard as any of them

effects.log: Five roots means five times the patience. You start getting up before the roosters. The chanting stops by itself, eventually.

choices.text: Learn a little of every element

effects.log: If your qi wants to go five ways, you will learn all five. It is slow. It is also, you notice, something none of them can do.

events.text: One night the five muddy elements of your false root turn, all together, for the first time: wood feeds fire, fire makes earth, earth bears metal, metal carries water, water feeds wood. Your Five Elements Physique was waiting for exactly this root. It was never false. It was waiting for a body that could turn it as one.

choices.text: Let the five turn until dawn

effects.log: By dawn the false root and the Five Elements body are one wheel, and it turns faster than any pure root. (Your training with this root is x1.2.)

choices.text: Go and find the children who chanted at you

effects.log: They are grown now, and stuck at Third-Rate. You do not say anything. You do not have to.
